links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT answers across two occasions on identical clinical cases
links.effect: ChatGPT-1 and ChatGPT-2 gave different answers in five occasions; mean scores 4.4 vs 4.15 out of 5.
links.quote: ChatGPT-1 and ChatGPT-2 gave different answers in five occasions.

links.outcome: ChatGPT agreement scores compared with otorhinolaryngologists on same cases
links.effect: ChatGPT-1 mean 4.4 (SD 1.2), ChatGPT-2 4.15 (SD 1.3), ENTs 4.91 (SD 0.3); Mann-Whitney U p < 0.001.
links.quote: The Mann-Whitney U test revealed a statistically significant difference (p < 0.001) between both ChatGPT's and the ENTs's score.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's diagnostic and management accuracy and consistency across clinical vignettes compared with ENT specialists.
